title: Does a completed simulation run mean a usable urban wind result for AI agents?
abstract: arXiv:2611.19385v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents based on large language models (LLMs) can now configure and run computational fluid dynamics (CFD) solvers, but a completed run does not ensure that delivered metrics can be recomputed from raw outputs. This gap was examined for urban wind simulation, where multi-case comparisons must hold non-target conditions fixed and reported values must be traceable to raw samples. UrbanWind-AgentBench, comprising 200 tasks and 367 cases in 10 engineering task families, was constructed. Public task contracts specify variable factors, fixed conditions, numerical thresholds and deliverable requirements, and two-layer scoring separates a structural score for deliverables, run provenance and raw evidence from a numerical score obtained by independent recomputation against references. WindPilot was then proposed as an execution framework that incorporates contract parsing, execution provenance, deterministic verification and bounded acceptance

translated_title: 一次完成的仿真运行对AI智能体而言就意味着可用的城市风场结果吗？
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的AI智能体如今已能够配置并运行计算流体动力学（CFD）求解器，但一次完成的运行并不能保证所交付的指标可以从原始输出中重新计算得到。本文针对城市风场仿真中的这一差距进行了考察：在该领域中，多案例比较必须保持非目标条件固定不变，且报告的数值必须可追溯至原始样本。研究构建了UrbanWind-AgentBench，涵盖10个工程任务族中的200个任务和367个案例。公开的任务契约规定了变量因素、固定条件、数值阈值和交付物要求，两层评分体系将针对交付物、运行溯源和原始证据的结构性评分，与通过对参考结果进行独立重算获得的数值评分区分开来。随后，本文提出了WindPilot作为执行框架，该框架融合了契约解析、执行溯源、确定性验证和有界接受机制。
tldr: 本文构建了包含200个任务和367个案例的UrbanWind-AgentBench基准，并提出两层评分体系与WindPilot执行框架，以确保AI智能体在城市风场CFD仿真中交付的结果具备可追溯性和可复算性，而非仅仅完成一次运行。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces UrbanWind-AgentBench, a benchmark of 200 tasks and 367 cases with a two-layer scoring system, along with WindPilot, an execution framework, to ensure that AI agents deliver traceable and recomputable urban wind CFD simulation results rather than merely completed runs.
